steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.setQuality('high'); g.bears.directorT=9999; g.env.weather.cloud=0.3; g.env.weather.cloudTarget=0.3; g.env.weather.timer=9999; const p=g.world.place('pier'); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,p.face+0.4); g.player.pitch=0.02; g.env.setTime(20); return 'ok'})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const p=g.world.place('pier'); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,p.face+0.4); g.player.pitch=0.02; return 'placed '+g.player.mode+' '+p.x.toFixed(0)+','+p.z.toFixed(0)})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const p=g.world.place('pier'); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,p.face+0.4); g.camera.position.set(g.player.pos.x,g.player.pos.y+1.7,g.player.pos.z); g.camera.rotation.set(0,p.face+0.4,0,'YXZ'); g.camera.updateMatrixWorld(); g.water.viewLevel=g.water.levelAhead(g.camera); const pr=g.water.probe; const pos=g.camera.position.clone(); pos.y=g.water.viewLevel+0.3; pr.update(g.renderer,g.scene,pos,5); const c=pr.camera; return 'cam '+g.camera.position.toArray().map(v=>v.toFixed(1)).join(',')+' probe '+c.position.toArray().map(v=>v.toFixed(2)).join(',')+' floor '+pr.floor.position.toArray().map(v=>v.toFixed(2)).join(',')})()

steps.saveEval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const probe=g.water.probe; const rt=probe.rt; const S=rt.width; const r=g.renderer; const h2f=(h)=>{const s=(h&0x8000)?-1:1, e=(h>>10)&0x1f, f=h&0x3ff; return e===0? s*Math.pow(2,-14)*(f/1024) : e===31? 0 : s*Math.pow(2,e-15)*(1+f/1024);}; const out=document.createElement('canvas'); out.width=S*4; out.height=S*3; const ctx=out.getContext('2d'); const pos=[[2,1],[0,1],[1,0],[1,2],[1,1],[3,1]]; const half=rt.texture.type===1016; for(let f=0;f<6;f++){ const buf=half?new Uint16Array(S*S*4):new Uint8Array(S*S*4); r.readRenderTargetPixels(rt,0,0,S,S,buf,f); const im=ctx.createImageData(S,S); for(let i=0;i<S*S;i++){ for(let c=0;c<3;c++){ let v=half?h2f(buf[i*4+c]):buf[i*4+c]/255; v=v/(1+v)*1.6; v=Math.pow(Math.max(0,v),1/2.2); im.data[((S-1-Math.floor(i/S))*S+(i%S))*4+c]=Math.min(255,v*255); } im.data[i*4+3]=255; } ctx.putImageData(im,pos[f][0]*S,pos[f][1]*S); } return out.toDataURL('image/png')})()
